more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Ammonia caramel is used as a color in food. Its technological role is to add or restore food colour.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include breakfast cereals, beer and malt beverages. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: 300 mg/kg body weight/day, combined caramel colours (EFSA, 2011). Within that group limit, E150c has a separate limit of 100 mg/kg body weight/day.
more_info.origin: Made by heating food-grade carbohydrates with ammonium compounds. Sulphite compounds are excluded from this class.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA identified uncertainties about manufacturing contaminants in 2011.
High-exposure estimates could exceed the group limit.
